title: Authority and execution workflow
body: Keep current rules, maintainer rationale and work/evidence separate. Follow the personal project-governance skill and its rules-decisions-work reference before contract review or record changes.

Protocol changes are spec-first: amend spec/rules.jsonl, formal/*.tla and spec/conformance.jsonl through spec-amend before implementation. Decisions and work must not carry hidden protocol requirements.

Architectural locks are decision-first and owner-first: resolve the unique owner/class through authority/ledgers.jsonl, then follow design-review and append the approved origin-qualified record to its owner ledger. Root retains language-neutral and cross-project authority; local bodies remain local.
New decision records must satisfy authority/README.md admission. Historical-only ledgers are relocation-only. Never copy a canonical body into an index or summary.

The concrete GraphReFly family authorization mapping remains proposed in graphrefly:B137. Do not invent its schema, migrate history without separate approval, or mint a D# merely for an attempt, rerun, receipt, incident, provider/model change or spend grant.

Use the personal bmad-build workflow within the local dispatch/Goal scope, its QA reference with local gates, and bmad-checkpoint-preview for human review. Ordinary delivery uses build-handoff mode; explicit checkpoint or --practice requests use interactive mode. These workflows do not change semantic approval or execution boundaries.

Protocol walkthroughs start in root authority and use runtime repositories as implementation evidence. Keep findings, rationale/questions and work/evidence separate in the indexed session; follow the user-selected topic and pacing.

title: Clean-slate migration and document maintenance
body: No backward compatibility across TS/Rust/Python clean-slate packages: during B49/B53 and later migrations, delete retired shapes directly; do not add legacy shims, compatibility aliases or old field/method facades unless a new locked decision explicitly reopens that constraint.

Use the activated protocol projection and its revision contract for current behavior. DS-1 preserves the full design narrative; old-main GRAPHREFLY-SPEC.md and COMPOSITION-GUIDE*.md remain migration/reference material under B7, not clean-slate authority.

Structured records are JSONL; prose has an index row. Shared public guidance defaults to guide-local JSONL records registered in guide/guide.jsonl. Follow guide/docs.jsonl for documentation ownership.

Resolved/superseded sessions move from sessions/active to sessions/archive with lifecycle in sessions/sessions.jsonl. Preserve historical text apart from required path corrections; do not infer success or approval from archival.

Run node dashboard/build.mjs --check after structured-record edits and before commit. After owner-ledger changes also run npm run authority:check:workspace. Passing checks establish references/evidence, not semantic acceptance.

title: Formal and runtime shell notes
body: The TLA+ Toolbox installation provides /Applications/TLA+ Toolbox.app/Contents/Eclipse/tla2tools.jar. Invoke java -cp "/Applications/TLA+ Toolbox.app/Contents/Eclipse/tla2tools.jar" tlc2.TLC -config <model>.cfg <model>.tla for an authorized model check.
Rust sibling repositories use mise-managed toolchains. Prefer mise exec -- cargo <cmd> and follow that repository's development instructions and observation discipline.
